RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: cannot responsibly be estimated from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Neither does it rule bias out. You and the successful candidate are both women, and nothing you describe specifically suggests sex influenced the decision.

Your longer experience deserves consideration, but years served are not the only legitimate criterion; digital expertise may have carried substantial weight.

Follow up your written request now. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on how your application was assessed. The unanswered request warrants follow-up, not an inference of discrimination.

If evidence emerges of sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or procedural breaches, raise those specifics. Check local complaint deadlines while awaiting a response.
